citation.title: Clinical survival and complication rate of ceramic veneers bonded to different substrates: A systematic review and meta-analysis
citation.authors: Alqutaibi AY, Saker S, Alghauli MA, Algabri RS, AbdElaziz MH

s_design.anchor: SR/meta-analysis of 6 clinical trials (1 RCT + 5 non-randomized cohort studies) comparing survival/complications of ceramic veneers bonded to different substrates (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100, via Step 2 routing note — the review pools mostly non-randomized studies)
s_design.evidence_quote: Of 973 screened articles, 6 clinical studies were included.

domains.evidence_quote: The protocol is available in the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO): CRD42021240267.
The database search yielded 5493 articles (PubMed=3177; Scopus=2267 and the Cochrane Library=49). The manual search resulted in 1 additional study.
Four records were excluded with reason
domains.note: the four excluded full-text records are individually identified by reference number (9,33-35) and given one specific, checkable shared reason (Fig. 1: "These articles did not include a comparison between ceramic veneers bonded to different substrates") — satisfies 3b-iii's low tier per DES v2.4 (a shared reason across individually-cited studies is still "each with its reason")

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: Two reviewers (A.Y.A., R.A.) evaluated each study's potential for bias separately. Any conflicts or discrepancies during the assessment were resolved by a third reviewer (M.A.A.).
if statistically significant heterogeneity (P<.10) was found, a random-effects model was used to assess the significance of treatment effects.

domains.note: Absence checked by reading the full Material and Methods / statistical-analysis section (search strategy → risk-of-bias tools → data categorization → pooling model → heterogeneity/I2 → RevMan). No funnel plot, Egger's test, or any 'publication bias' wording appears anywhere in the text (Methods, Results, or Discussion).

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement anywhere in the text at all, or funding by a commercial manufacturer whose own product is among those tested
penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
penalties.note: CoI explicitly declared as none; funded by the Deputyship for Research & Innovation, Ministry of Education, Saudi Arabia — a government academic funder, not a manufacturer, and no single company's product is under test.

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.note: not applicable — this is an SR/MA, not a primary RCT

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis (clinical studies); for in-vitro, specimen count per group <10 with no justification
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires (e.g. survival claims with <3y follow-up)
penalties.evidence_quote: the short-term follow-up periods in most studies may not provide a comprehensive understanding of long-term outcomes and veneer longevity.
penalties.note: The review's own limitations paragraph states most included studies had short-term follow-up (individual studies range ~2–3 years) while the paper draws survival/success conclusions.

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز شواهد این منبع ۵۲ از ۱۰۰ و باند C است؛ نوع سوال Therapy است.
sources.interpretation_fa: این مرور سیستماتیک و متاآنالیز روی ۶ مطالعه بالینی (عمدتاً غیر تصادفی‌سازی‌شده) با پروتکل ثبت‌شده در PROSPERO انجام شده و جست‌وجوی دیتابیس و ارزیابی ریسک بایاس با دو ارزیاب مستقل به‌طور کامل توصیف شده‌اند. اما ارزیابی publication bias در متن ذکر نشده و پیگیری بیشتر مطالعات کوتاه‌مدت بوده، دو نقطه‌ضعفی که اعتبار یافته‌های بقا و موفقیت را محدود می‌کند بدون آنکه آن‌ها را بی‌اعتبار کند.

claims.claim_quote: محدوده‌های گزارش‌شده: انامل ۹۸ تا ۱۰۰ برای هر دو شاخص؛ اکسپوژر حداقل دنتین ۹۱ تا ۱۰۰ برای بقا و ۹۰ تا ۹۹ برای موفقیت؛ کامپوزیت موجود ۹۱ تا ۹۷ و ۶۰ تا ۸۰؛ اکسپوژر شدید دنتین ۸۴ تا ۹۸ و ۶۴ تا ۸۵.
claims.source_quote: The pooled survival rates were 99% (range 98% to 100%) when CVs were bonded to enamel,10,22,30–32 94% (range 91% to 97%) when CVs were bonded to existing composite resin restorations,10,22,31 95% (range 91% to 100%) when CVs were bonded to surfaces with minimal dentin exposure,29,30 and 91% (range 84% to 98%) when CVs were bonded to surfaces with severe dentin exposure29,30 (Fig. 2).
claims.note: success ranges are in the following pooled-success sentence and agree

claims.claim_quote: نکته‌ی کلیدی جدول این است که در انامل و در اکسپوژر حداقل دنتین، دو عدد بقا و موفقیت تقریباً یکی هستند.
claims.source_quote: Enamel-bonded veneers had almost perfect rates of survival (99% with a range of 98% to 100%) and success (99% with a range of 98% to 100%).
claims.note: minimal dentin exposure 95% and 95% is in the abstract sentence on composite and minimal dentin

claims.claim_quote: اما در کامپوزیت موجود و در اکسپوژر شدید دنتین، ونیر معمولاً سر جایش می‌ماند ولی برای نگه داشتنش مداخله لازم شده است.
claims.source_quote: Veneers bonded to composite resin or surfaces with minimal dentin exposure had slightly lower survival rates (94% with a range of 91% to 97% and 95% with a range of 91% to 100%, respectively) and success rates (70% with a range of 60% to 80% and 95% with a range of 90% to 99%).
claims.note: severe dentin exposure 91% versus 74% is in the abstract severe-exposure sentence

claims.claim_quote: کامپوزیت موجود از این نظر بدترین گروه بود؛ حدود ۳۰٪ ونیرها در طول پیگیری به مداخله نیاز پیدا کردند.
claims.source_quote: Veneers bonded to composite resin or surfaces with minimal dentin exposure had slightly lower survival rates (94% with a range of 91% to 97% and 95% with a range of 91% to 100%, respectively) and success rates (70% with a range of 60% to 80% and 95% with a range of 90% to 99%).
claims.note: ranking as worst group is not stated by any sentence (silent half); 30% is the complement of the 70% success rate

claims.claim_quote: در مقایسه مستقیم، ونیرهای باندشده به دنتین عوارض و شکست بیشتری نسبت به ونیرهای باندشده به انامل داشتند.
claims.source_quote: The enamel is the perfect surface for CV adhesion; fewer clinical complications and failure incidences were reported, with high success and survival rates in comparison with other substrates.30–32
claims.note: conclusion 3 says absolute failure was similar, although enamel was more favorable

claims.claim_quote: همچنین ونیرهای روی دنتین با اکسپوژر حداقل، نسبت به اکسپوژر شدید، به‌طور معنی‌داری کمتر به مداخله کلینیکی نیاز پیدا کردند.
claims.source_quote: Additionally, veneers attached to teeth with minimal dentin exposure were significantly less likely to require clinical interventions (RD: −0.16; 95% CI: −0.31 to −0.01) and had a reduced incidence of failure (RD: −0.08; 95% CI: −0.17 to 0.01) compared with those with severe dentin exposure.

claims.claim_quote: چرا باند به دنتین دردسر بیشتری دارد

claims.source_quote: Bonding to enamel relies mainly on resin tags to provide reliable and durable bonds, as documented by long-term clinical trials and in vitro studies.14,15

claims.claim_quote: دنتین به دلیل ماهیت مرطوبش سطح دشوارتری است و نفوذ رزین در آن می‌تواند ناقص بماند.

claims.claim_quote: مقاله تأکید می‌کند که با پروتکل ادهزیو مناسب و آماده‌سازی درست سطح، باند بادوام به دنتین هم قابل دستیابی است.

claims.source_quote: Most clinical complications have been associated with the loss of adhesion, particularly recurrent caries, microleakage, marginal discoloration, and veneer fractures.10,22,29–31

claims.claim_quote: در بسیاری از موارد شکست هم، قطعه‌ی شکسته پیش از fracture اتصالش را از دست داده بود؛ یعنی loss of adhesion ممکن است مقدم بر شکست باشد.
claims.source_quote: In many situations, the nonfractured parts remained attached to the underlying substrate, indicating that the fractured part encountered attachment loss before fracture.10,29,32

claims.source_quote: The available evidence indicates that regardless of the fabrication technique, a marginal gap is inevitable.

claims.claim_quote: با این حال ونیرهای glass-ceramic ساخته‌شده به روش heat-pressed، fit داخلی و مارژینال بهتر و microleakage کمتری نسبت به ونیرهای CAD-CAM نشان داده‌اند.
claims.source_quote: Nevertheless, heatpressed glass-ceramic veneers exhibited better internal and marginal fit and less microleakage compared with CADCAM fabricated veneers.48,54

claims.claim_quote: ارقام شکست مطلق
claims.note: heading, label, table cell or signpost only

claims.claim_quote: در داده‌های این مرور، میزان absolute failure برای ونیرهای باندشده به ترمیم‌های کامپوزیتی موجود ۲۵/۳٪ و برای ونیرهای باندشده به substrate دندانی بدون ترمیم ۹/۵٪ گزارش شده است.
claims.source_quote: CVs bonded to teeth with existing composite resin restorations displayed double and half the incidence of absolute failure compared with those bonded to tooth substrates without restorations (25.3% versus 9.5%, respectively).

claims.claim_quote: نویسندگان در نتیجه‌گیری این اختلاف را به‌عنوان یکی از یافته‌های مهم مطالعه مطرح کرده‌اند.
claims.source_quote: CVs bonded to teeth with existing composite resin restorations displayed double and half the incidence of absolute failure compared with those bonded to tooth substrates without restorations (25.3% versus 9.5%, respectively).
claims.note: listed as one of the five conclusions

claims.claim_quote: در مورد دنتین هم تفاوت قابل‌توجه بود: absolute failure در اکسپوژر حداقل ۹/۵٪ و در اکسپوژر شدید ۳۰/۶٪ گزارش شد.
claims.source_quote: CVs bonded to teeth with severe dentin exposure demonstrated a significantly higher absolute failure rate than CVs luted to teeth with minimal dentin exposure, with failure rates of 30.6% versus 9.5%, respectively.

claims.claim_quote: محدودیت‌های مطالعه
claims.note: heading, label, table cell or signpost only

claims.claim_quote: این نتایج باید با توجه به محدودیت‌های مطالعه تفسیر شوند.
claims.note: heading, label, table cell or signpost only

claims.claim_quote: تنها ۶ مطالعه بالینی وارد مرور شدند و مطالعات از نظر طراحی، تعداد نمونه و مدت پیگیری با هم تفاوت داشتند.
claims.source_quote: Of 973 screened articles, 6 clinical studies were included.
claims.note: second half (designs, sample sizes, follow-up varied) is the limitations sentence

claims.claim_quote: تمام مطالعات روی glass-matrix ceramics انجام شده بودند، اما در برخی از آن‌ها داده‌های انواع مختلف سرامیک، از جمله feldspathic، leucite-reinforced و lithium disilicate، جداگانه گزارش نشده بود.
claims.source_quote: Furthermore, all the included studies concentrated on Alqutaibi et al 9 glass-matrix ceramics without separate data for feldspathic ceramic, leucite-reinforced ceramics, and lithium disilicate glass CVs in some studies.

claims.claim_quote: بنابراین بر اساس این مرور نمی‌توان عملکرد این مواد را مستقل از یکدیگر مقایسه کرد.
claims.note: inference: that the materials cannot be compared independently is not stated by the source

claims.claim_quote: نویسندگان همچنین اشاره می‌کنند که follow-up در بیشتر مطالعات نسبتاً کوتاه بوده و ممکن است برای ارزیابی نتایج بلندمدت و longevity ونیر کافی نباشد.
claims.source_quote: Also, the short-term follow-up periods in most studies may not provide a comprehensive understanding of long-term outcomes and veneer longevity.

claims.claim_quote: جمع‌بندی
claims.note: heading, label, table cell or signpost only

claims.claim_quote: انامل مطلوب‌ترین substrate برای ونیرهای سرامیکی است.
claims.source_quote: The enamel is the perfect surface for CV adhesion; fewer clinical complications and failure incidences were reported, with high success and survival rates in comparison with other substrates.30–32

claims.claim_quote: ونیرهای باندشده به انامل بالاترین میزان بقا و موفقیت را داشتند، هر دو ۹۹٪.
claims.source_quote: Ceramic veneers bonded to enamel showed higher survival and success rates with lower clinical incidences of complications and failure than those bonded to dentin or teeth with existing composite resin restorations.
claims.note: the 99% figures are in the abstract sentence on enamel-bonded veneers

claims.claim_quote: باند به کامپوزیت رزینی موجود با survival حدود ۹۴٪ همراه بود، اما success به ۷۰٪ کاهش یافت.
claims.source_quote: Veneers bonded to composite resin or surfaces with minimal dentin exposure had slightly lower survival rates (94% with a range of 91% to 97% and 95% with a range of 91% to 100%, respectively) and success rates (70% with a range of 60% to 80% and 95% with a range of 90% to 99%).

claims.claim_quote: در اکسپوژر حداقل دنتین، survival و success هر دو حدود ۹۵٪ بودند.
claims.source_quote: Veneers bonded to composite resin or surfaces with minimal dentin exposure had slightly lower survival rates (94% with a range of 91% to 97% and 95% with a range of 91% to 100%, respectively) and success rates (70% with a range of 60% to 80% and 95% with a range of 90% to 99%).

claims.claim_quote: اما در اکسپوژر شدید دنتین، survival به ۹۱٪ و success به ۷۴٪ رسید.
claims.source_quote: Severe dentin exposure significantly decreased both survival rates (91% with a range of 84% to 98%) and success rates (74% with a range of 64% to 85%).

claims.claim_quote: بنابراین از دیدگاه این مقاله، حفظ حداکثری انامل و انتخاب دقیق substrate هنگام preparation از عوامل مهم در کاهش عوارض و افزایش longevity ونیرهای سرامیکی هستند.
claims.source_quote: The conservation of tooth enamel during preparation for ceramic veneers is critical for reliable bonding and a high rate of clinical success.
claims.note: careful substrate assessment and enamel maintenance also stated later in the Discussion

claims.claim_quote: جایی که دنتین یا کامپوزیت موجود بخش قابل‌توجهی از substrate را تشکیل می‌دهد، باید با دقت بیشتری سراغ surface treatment، bonding protocol، IDS در اکسپوژر وسیع دنتین، بررسی fit ونیر و استراتژی‌های پیشگیرانه رفت.
claims.source_quote: Precautions should be taken before bonding ceramic veneers to dentin or existing composite resin restorations, including proper surface treatment and bonding protocols that should optimize the survival rate.
claims.note: IDS and fit assessment are stated in Discussion as strategies that 'may include'

fidelity.source_conclusion: CVs bonded to teeth with severe dentin exposure demonstrated a significantly higher absolute failure rate than CVs luted to teeth with minimal dentin exposure, with failure rates of 30.6% versus 9.5%, respectively.
fidelity.fact_fa: از ۴۹ ادعایی که منبع به آن پرداخته‌اند، ۴۹ مورد مطابق است، ۰ مورد تغییر یافته و ۰ مورد برعکس؛ سطح انطباق بالا؛ ۵ جمله‌ی دیگر در منبع نیامده است.
fidelity.interpretation_fa: هر ادعای قابل‌بررسی با منبع مطابق است.
